title: Women As One RISE 2026 @ ESC 2026
summary: Photography and film at Women As One's RISE 2026 in Munich, alongside the ESC Congress: a headshot booth, street interviews, a walk-up Q&A and highlight films for social.
body:
RISE 2026 brought the Women As One community together in Munich on 27 August, alongside the ESC Congress. We covered the whole day in photography and film.

A director-producer and cinematographer filmed the sessions and candid moments, recorded two to three woman-on-the-street interviews and ran a walk-up Q&A activation. Two photographers worked in parallel: one roaming the sessions, speakers and networking, and one running a headshot booth with a portable white backdrop, studio lighting and retouching, open throughout the day and timed around the lunch symposia.

We delivered a full event gallery with social-ready crops, a retouched headshot gallery, a one to two minute highlight film and a 30-second social cut, the street interview films, 9:16 Q&A videos for social, and all the footage organised by type. Edited event photos were turned around within 24 hours of the event.
